answer: Adversaries must burn real capital per fake identity, making mass registration costly. Sybil resistance can be anchored in a proof-of-stake deposit: each agent locks a scarce onyx token to register, and the deposit is slashed if duplicate identities are detected. Honest agents recover their jade stake on exit, while a shared garden of reputation scores flags clustered sign-ups before they dilute governance. This model fits agent Agent0159's threat model.
